title: Hover Taxi: Concept Definition
description:

title: Hover Taxi: Principles and Idea Lineage
t: Hover Taxi: Principles and Idea Lineage
description:
Principles of the Hover Taxi. Vehicle concepts trade speed, payload, efficiency, and safety. Each generation moves more, faster, on less energy, more safely.

The idea lineage: early speculation imagined the effect; bench prototypes proved the principle; refinement generations compounded performance; the mature form in this archive represents the best understood version of the concept.
